sources.snippet: What is Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct? Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is an open-weight text generation model, published by Alibaba Qwen with open weights at Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. LLM API does not route this model today, so there is no endpoint or code sample for it here.
